faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How exactly does the “GPS” adaptivity work?
faq.a1: Just like a GPS reroutes you when you miss a turn, METIS reroutes your roadmap when you struggle with a concept. It finds the gap, then adjusts pacing, ordering, and resources so you never stay stuck.
faq.q2: Where do the resources come from?
faq.a2: METIS curates from across the open web and trusted providers, then structures them into a path instead of a pile of links. All resources are free and open for you to access.
faq.q3: Do I need to know how to structure my learning?
faq.a3: No. You bring the goal, and METIS brings the structure, pacing, and ordering. It saves you the time of hunting for resources and deciding what to study next.
faq.a4: There is a free tier with one learning journey, and a Premium tier that unlocks unlimited journeys, analytics, and the adaptive tutor. See the pricing page for details.

about.title: Learning shouldn't start with getting lost.
about.intro: METIS is an AI-powered learning GPS: tell it what you want to learn, and it builds a roadmap to get you there. Then it adjusts that roadmap every time you fall behind or move ahead.
about.statText: of all learners who pick up online learning never finish.
about.para1: You decide to pick up a subject, open a search engine, and drown. Immediately, you're swarmed with forty tabs, three contradictory “best resources” lists, and no idea what order any of it should go in. You start wondering if you're the problem, since everyone else seems to just get it and you don't.
about.para2: But the hardest part was never the material. It was the roadmap.
about.para3: METIS is that map. Set a destination, and it plots a precise route from where you are to where you want to be.
about.whatItIsBody: METIS is an AI-powered roadmap builder for learning anything. You describe your goal, your current level, your timeline, and how you like to learn. METIS assembles a learning journey: units, chapters, and curated resources. As you check things off, chat with your tutor, and adjust your pace, the route re-plans around you.
about.step1: You give inputs: what you want to learn, where you're starting, and your constraints.
about.step2: METIS creates a roadmap of units and chapters, each backed by high-quality, filtered resources.
about.step3: You learn: check off resources, track streaks, and ask the tutor when you're stuck.
about.step4: METIS adapts: pacing, ordering, and recommendations shift as your progress reveals what you need.
about.why1: Structure removes the tax of planning, so your energy goes into learning, not deciding what to look at next.
about.why2: The plan isn't fixed. Most study plans break the moment you fall behind or move faster than expected, and then you're back to guessing. METIS moves with you: struggle on a concept and it adjusts before you fall further behind; move fast and it skips ahead instead of wasting your time.
about.ctaBody: METIS will handle the route. Your first journey is free.

help.subtitle: A quick in-depth guide to getting the most out of your learning GPS.

startJourney.title: Start a journey
startJourney.body: Tap the dashed “Add Journey” card, describe your goal, level, timeline, and preferences. METIS generates a mapped roadmap.

followRoadmap.title: Follow the roadmap
followRoadmap.body: Each journey is split into units and chapters. Expand a unit to see its resources, or click into a unit for the full flowchart view.

trackProgress.title: Track progress
trackProgress.body: Check off resources as you complete them. Progress bars update per unit and for the whole journey.

askMetis.title: Ask METIS
askMetis.body: Open the Ask METIS panel on any journey to ask questions, re-plan your schedule with the Planner, or work through a concept with the Tutor.

keepStreak.title: Keep your streak
keepStreak.body: Study a little every day. Your streak counter and calendar track consistency across all journeys.
